gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-khmer: Noto Sans Khmer is a modern sans whose small letters stand proud, nearly capital-sized, with generous notch-like openings. Oxanium earns its keep big and short, with a single stroke thickness throughout.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-khudawadi: Oxanium draws like a marker, one constant line. Noto Sans Khudawadi brings sans letters with little gap between capital and body height, and rounds left open like an unlatched hook.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-lao: Noto Sans Lao pushes its x-height well above the usual, with mouths that stay open. Noto Sans Lao would read steadily over pages, while Oxanium keeps its monoline strokes for headings.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-lepcha: Approachable is Noto Sans Lepcha, with curves that keep a wide opening. Its lowercase carries the stature of cast iron capitals, so extended reading in this sans-serif stays steady beside Oxanium's monoline headings.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-mahajani: Lowercase stands tall against the capitals here, and the e opens a funnel-wide throat. Noto Sans Mahajani is the sans-serif for text, while Oxanium does its best work in headings drawn with one fixed nib.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-marchen: Oxanium holds a monoline stroke from start to finish. Noto Sans Marchen stands its small letters up proud, nearly capital-sized, in a sans-serif whose curves end in clear daylight.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-mayan-numera: Oxanium traces like a laser-etched line, constant in width. Noto Sans Mayan Numerals sits beneath it as a sans with tall-bodied small letters and a visibly gaping c at any size.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-mende-kikaku: Every stroke in Oxanium is rod-stock uniform, horizontals and verticals alike. Noto Sans Mende Kikakui joins it as a sans with daylight through every curve and lowercase standing tall against the capitals.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-meroitic: Oxanium looks machined, its round bowls uniform all the way. Noto Sans Meroitic keeps reading comfortable line after line, its c openings visible and its lowercase filling the line like capitals.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-sans-modi: Oxanium keeps rounds and stems all in a single weight, with a high x-height that makes lowercase look big. Noto Sans Modi reads smoothly, with daylight inside every curve.
